purpose: First independent tactic comparison: same strategy, production, observation and execution bridge; batch same-goal marching tanks using the existing native group command

decision.budget: 16 new starts, inspect all outcomes before retaining the tactic
decision.invariants: Strategy, production, contracts, bridge and effects source hashes must match. Only the tactic and its default wiring differ. Actor observations and scoring are unchanged.
decision.mechanism: Verify multi-unit marching commands were actually submitted. Reconstruct the first town/counter run for each variant to inspect whether early armor participates together; fewer commands alone are not evidence of stronger combat.
decision.next: Keep the behavior-preserving individual tactic if grouping fails to improve the observed participation issue or introduces a material cost. Any strength claim requires a larger frozen comparison. No RPA capability is inferred.
